column3: Demo for Webflow Marketplace review · Data Client app
In Alphaa, the owner picks their website builder. Webflow starts Webflow's OAuth flow (Shopify and WordPress are other options; Wix is coming soon).
Webflow shows exactly what Alphaa can do: read sites; read + edit CMS items; read + edit page settings.
If the owner clicks Cancel, Alphaa gets nothing. It explains nothing was connected and offers "Try again".
This time the owner selects a site and clicks Authorize App.
Alphaa confirms the connection. It found the site's blog collection and its required fields automatically.
Alphaa drafts posts that answer the questions AI assistants ask about the business. Nothing is published without approval.
The owner reviews the draft (and can edit it), then taps "Do it on my site".
Alphaa creates a live CMS item in the Webflow blog collection and links to it. Every change gets an Undo.
The post is live on the site, styled by the site's own Collection template.
One tap on Undo unpublishes the item. Alphaa never deletes content: the item stays in the CMS as a draft.
After Undo, the post is no longer on the published site.
Settings › Website connection shows the site, checks the connection, and lets the owner reconnect, switch, or disconnect (which revokes the token).
